replacement: 2. Make sure the shared namespace directory (`mycompany/`) in each repo has no `__init__.py` (PEP 420); the subpackages under it (`mycompany/auth/`) may.

evidence.docstring: Detection covers the project root AND every configured package and namespace

problem: Lists 'Check installed packages in environment', which no detector does, and says detection 'happens when project loads'. Detection reads the project root and every configured package and namespace path, at server startup and again after configure_packages; it never looks at the environment.
replacement: Each plugin looks for framework-specific files (`manage.py`, Flask entry points such as `app.py`), framework imports in Python files, and requirement files (`requirements.txt`, `Pipfile`, and for Flask and Pydantic `pyproject.toml`), in the project root and every configured package and namespace path. Detection runs at server startup and again after `configure_packages` changes the layout.
route_reason: Detection steps are code paths, not an exposed value; no MCP tool call demonstrates them.
